description: List recent published or failed posts, each with a `results` array of per-platform outcomes: `status` ('success', 'failed', or 'pending' — accepted by the platform but not yet confirmed), plus `error` and the platform's own `failReason` code when delivery failed. Use to see which platforms a post landed on and why any of them didn't. A pending entry resolves within a few minutes; read the post again rather than republishing it.
name: list_post_results
title: List post results
